parent.k4j_limit: bounded conventional 1NN only, high inference cost/size

source.policy_implementation: frozen K4I raw observation 1NN scoring function

models.outcome_aware_select: Within each family/action FIT records chronological by frozen variant id: choose minimum-reward record; maximum-reward record (or next unused variant if tied); then greedily add record with maximum minimum *squared raw public feature distance* to selected records, breaking ties by lower FIT variant id, until four. Never use CHECK/DEV rewards.
models.coverage_select: Start at lowest FIT variant id per arm; add farthest raw-feature record greedily as above to four.
models.uniform_select: Select FIT chronological variant indices 0,3,6,9 (four of 12) per arm.
models.same_predictor: K4I unmodified raw nearest-neighbor per-action reward lookup, winner highest predicted reward, ties lowest arm ID. Compressed states differ only in which original FIT records retained. No changes to original K4I predictor.
models.baselines: Full 12 per arm raw 1NN, per-family mean-action policy, K4I ridge and fixed low. FIT data equally available to all models.
models.preregistered_primary: Outcome-aware 4 vs full 12 and FIT family mean; coverage 4 and uniform 4 as conventional compressed counterfactual controls.
models.primary_advancement: On REACHING new DEV, full 1NN must beat trained family mean by >0; compressed outcome-aware 4 must beat trained family mean by >=0.01 mean reward, retain >=0.80 of full-12 positive margin, strictly improve >=2 of 4 variants, select >=2 distinct actions; outcome-aware serialized checkpoint bytes <=0.5 of full-12 bytes and repeated identical-input per-method inference CPU <=0.65 of full-12. All criteria required; report if any fail; no selection of favorable methods based on DEV.
models.honest_comparison: Report each fixed method's DEV rewards/selected arms, per-task family, CHECK, source-initial hashes, baseline and compressed checkpoints; any exploratory best-method comparison marked multiple comparisons.
models.fit_gate: Require 12 distinct public FIT observations and >=2 distinct actual FIT reward-winner actions on reaching, else do not consume either CHECK or DEV.
models.resource_protocol: Measure actual per-method inference process CPU nanoseconds over 200 complete passes of all 12 heldout public contexts in fixed method order; each repeated request checks same frozen selected action. Report shared FIT training CPU, total execution CPU/wall RSS, method saved model bytes and all original physics episodes. Ignore CPU timing values only in across-process source equality comparison.
models.negative_rule: No change to frozen cohorts, bounds, model selection, compression criteria, FIT preprocessing, action menu or numerical thresholds after first execution, preserve all originals and lack of qualification.
claims_forbidden: resource Pareto improvement without meeting both size/time
